newsitem.title: USA: Florida approves four issues totalling $79.95 mln.
newsitem.headline: Florida approves four issues totalling $79.95 mln.

text.p: Florida's Board of Administration approved four revenue bond issues totalling $79.95 million Tuesday, the state Division of Bond Finance said.
All four are to be sold by competitive bid.

The panel approved three Board of Regents issues -- $40.395 million of University System Improvement Revenue Bonds, Series 1997; $19.445 million of University of Central Florida Housing Revenue Bonds issue, Series 1996; and $10.5 million University of South Florida Housing Facilities Revenue Bonds, Series 1996.
The board also approved $9.6 million of Florida Faciliites Pool revenue bonds to fund land aquisition and construction of a new state office building in Tallahassee.
The Board of Administration consists of the governor and the state comptroller and treasurer.
